newsitem.title: USA: Angeion gets FDA approval for wider trial.
newsitem.headline: Angeion gets FDA approval for wider trial.

text.p: Angeion Corp said it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to expand U.S. clinical studies of the Sentinel 2000 and 2010 implantable defibrillator systems and AngeFlex dual pass lead system to 35 centers across the country.
This is an expansion of 1O centers with additional patient clinical evaluations, said the medical device maker.
Angeion also said it received approval to add the Sentinel 2011 and 2012 to Angeion's U.S. clinical studies.
All the Sentinels are devices implanted in the body and connected to the heart by wires. They transmit electrical charges to the heart to keep it from beating too fast.
